description: Check the user's identity verification (KYC) status. Returns whether they are verified and, if not, the current state plus the conversational next step. Use this to poll after the user does the face scan, or any time create_card reports kyc_required.
name: get_kyc_status

nextStep.description: Conversational next step when the flow is in progress.

reason.description: Failure reason from the verification provider when one exists.

status.description: Raw KYC state: "verified", "pending", "requires_input", "duplicate_identity", "canceled", or null if never started.

verified.description: True when identity verification has passed.
